\section{Diagonal upper bound: theorem and proof architecture}

For positive integers \(k,\ell\), let \(R(k,\ell)\) be the least \(n\) such
that every red--blue colouring of \(K_n\) contains either a red \(K_k\) or a
blue \(K_\ell\).  The classical argument of Erd\H{o}s and Szekeres gives
\(R(k,k)\le 4^{k+o(k)}\) \cite{ErdosSzekeres1935}.  Campos, Griffiths,
Morris and Sahasrabudhe obtained the first exponential improvement of this
base \cite{CGMS2023}.  Gupta, Ndiaye, Norin and Wei subsequently reorganized
the book method and stated the concrete bound \(R(k,k)\le3.8^{k+o(k)}\)
\cite{GNNW2024}.  Yang and Mao introduced a retained-spine refinement in a
multicolour setting \cite{YangMao2026}.

This part combines two ingredients.  The first is a certified, symmetric
off-diagonal rate
\[
 \log R(k,\ell)\le kU(\ell/k)+o(k),\qquad 1\le \ell\le k,
 \tag{U1.1}\label{up:main:eq:1-1}
\]
where \(U=F_6\) is given explicitly in \cref{up:sec:rate}.  The second is a new
correlation certificate designed for the retained-spine transfer.  The
certificate is analytic except on compact intervals, where every inequality
is proved by outward-rounded Arb balls \cite{Johansson2017}.

\subsection{Main result}

We state the result with its imported interfaces visible.  The exact
interfaces are recorded in \cref{up:sec:framework}; they are theorem statements
from Yang--Mao together with the reviewed rate theorem \eqref{up:main:eq:1-1}, rather than
unstructured assumptions about an implementation.

\begin{theorem}[Conditional main theorem]\label{up:thm:main-upper}
Assume the version-pinned regularization, parameterized-book, and
spine-compatibility interfaces stated in \cref{up:ass:yang-mao}, and the
certified rate theorem \cref{up:thm:p6-rate}.  The positive-moment and tail
implication used to establish the correlation input are proved locally in
\cref{up:sec:exact}.  Then
\[
 R(k,k)\le \exp\!\left((U(1)-3.4754\cdot10^{-6})k+o(k)\right)
 \le (3.780685290)^{k+o(k)}.
\]
The certified unrounded upper base is less than
\(3.780685288379640114\).
\end{theorem}

This part is a source-relative proof package: every imported statement is
named, every new inequality is proved here, and every numerical step is
replayable by separately structured implementations.  Those implementations
share Arb's interval-containment semantics as a trust dependency.  No finite
value of the asymptotic threshold is claimed.

\subsection{The exact-diagonal mechanism}

Fix
\[
 u_0=\frac{1235783}{500000},\qquad L=u_0^3,
 \qquad a=e^{-u_0},
\]
and define
\[
 E(z)=\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{z^n}{(3n)!},\qquad
 H(z)=1+aE(z)^2,\qquad
 G(z)=\frac{H(z)-H(-z)}2.
\]
The correlation form is
\[
 F(x,y)=G(x)H(y)+G(y)H(x).
\]
Our central observation is that the complete two-dimensional problem reduces
to the exact identity
\[
 F(z,z)=H(z)^2-H(z)H(-z),\qquad z\ge0,
\]
not merely to the larger square difference
\(H(z)^2-H(-z)^2\).  This improves the compact envelope while preserving a
simple analytic tail.

\subsection{Proof architecture}

The proof has four logically separate layers.

\begin{enumerate}[label=(\roman*)]
\item \Cref{up:sec:rate} states the off-diagonal rate and records its exact
      polynomial and verification boundary.
\item \Cref{up:sec:exact} proves the ratio/separator, the two-dimensional
      reduction, the exact diagonal envelope and the moment/tail budget.
\item \Cref{up:sec:transfer} proves the retained-spine max--min transfer and
      inserts the certified parameters.
\item \Cref{up:sec:computation} describes continuum coverage, independent
      implementations and the content-addressed evidence records.
\end{enumerate}

The complete repaired book induction and the frozen rate record are included
in the appendices.  Search scripts are not part of the proof; they only chose
the exact rational data subsequently verified from scratch.
